reason: QoderWork authorizes on the portal that serves its account picker, under its own OAuth client and its own deep link, so a QoderWork login is a distinct session from any other Qoder-family login on the same machine. The browser entry accepts six device-flow parameters and no API-only security state. The host forwards the engine URL unchanged and opens it; a failed browser handoff does not cancel the flow, because the settings card also shows the URL.
